game_concept: A adventure race set in Mt. Pyre – Magma Forge, a forge fed by magma: the ash ranger must handle fire sprites while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Arithmetic Cannon: Choose +, -, *, / or // to build a damage formula that exactly matches a shield number on fire sprites.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Magma Forge: a forge fed by magma
core_gameplay_loop: In Magma Forge, repeat each round: Choose +, -, *, / or // to build a damage formula that exactly matches a shield number on fire sprites. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the ash ranger ahead. Then check the damage value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the summit beacon by solving code steps involving damage that move the ash ranger forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.9).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the summit beacon first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 9 (extended tier): Arithmetic Cannon
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Arithmetic Cannon' (Week 2 slot 2), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Magma Forge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how damage changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against fire sprites in Magma Forge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.9).
